[BUREAU OF ENGINEERING]
BPW-2026-0507
CD 15
FINAL CLOSEOUT CHANGE ORDER NO. 060 – MURRAY PLUMBING AND HEATING CORPORATION DBA MURRAY COMPANY
Recommending the Board:
AUTHORIZE the City Engineer to issue Final Closeout Change Order No. 060 for the Hyperion Water Reclamation Plant Capital Improvement Project 2445 Primary Tanks B0, B5, and C0 Upgrades, 2446 Primary Tanks Skimmer Improvements, and 2477 Primary Influent Sluice Gates to resolve all outstanding issues and claims and credit the City of Los Angeles for the unexpended amount from the Fixed Cash Allowance Bid Item No. 7.
(W.O.: SZH11783, SZH11829, SZH11924, C-133245)
